Our engineering team is actively working on a hotfix.

In the meantime, here is the recommended workaround to keep your AP team moving:
1. Switch the affected invoice channels to Manual Entry mode (Admin > eInvoice > Channels).
2. Hold non-critical month-end OCR batches until the hotfix is deployed, and process any critical invoices manually.

Please note that clearing caches or re-uploading invoices will not resolve this, so I'd recommend against spending time on that.

I've escalated this as a P1 and linked it to the active incident so it's being tracked with the engineering team. I'll keep you updated as the hotfix progresses. Given the volume of invoices in your queue, I've also flagged this to your account team so we can support you through month-end close.
